overview_description.description: GoDefi is a Web3 fintech platform that provides a non-custodial decentralised finance (DeFi) payment system connecting cryptocurrency wallets to real-world payments. The platform enables users to link their personal crypto wallets and spend digital assets directly through a payment card without transferring funds to centralised intermediaries.

product.name: DeFi Wallet Integration
product.description: A service that allows users to connect their Solana wallets to GoDefi without sharing private keys, enabling non-custodial access to funds.

product.name: DeFi Lending Protocol
product.description: A protocol allowing users to lend their crypto assets to earn passive income with specified annual percentage yields (APY).

product.description: A service that enables users to borrow cryptocurrency funds against their assets for spending without selling them.
